'''Alchaka''' was an extremely personal [[Force power/Legends|ritual]] performed during [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] by members of the [[Je'daii Order]] and later the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Drawing on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Alchaka was utilized as a vigorous martial arts form by the Je'daii Order.

==Description==
The Alchaka [[Meditation/Legends|meditations]] were a rigorous series of highly personal, highly repetitive exercises using both physical and [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|skills]]. Consisting of a high number of repetitions performed in complex positions and dizzying movements spaced between the positions, completing the meditations correctly typically left the practitioner on the brink of exhaustion. The purpose of the Alchaka technique was to clear the mind and attune the body to the strength of the Force, and was considered an advanced form of [[Moving Meditation]].<ref name="TCWWS" />

==History==
Developed as a martial arts<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> form by the early [[Je'daii Master]]s of the [[Stav Kesh]] academy on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the Alchaka meditations were a highly personalized meditative technique that brought practitioners to the brink of exhaustion and closer still to the Force. At the time, members of the [[Je'daii Order]] would often joke that the meditations were invented to keep warm, as Stav Kesh was located high in the snow-capped mountain ranges of the planet.<ref name="DOTJ" /> Alchaka could be combined with other martial combat moves to form an efficient and dangerous weaponless attack.<ref name="Into the Void" />

Over the centuries, the Je'daii left Tython and relocated to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] where they renamed themselves the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The technique of Alchaka was passed down from generation to generation, surviving longer than any of the academies it was taught at. Nearly [[22 BBY/Legends|twenty five thousand years]] after it was created, Alchaka was still taught at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] took the meditations very seriously, becoming slightly upset when [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] witnessed his practicing while aboard the ship ferrying them to [[Zigoola]] on a vital Jedi [[Mission to Zigoola|assignment]].<ref name="TCWWS" />
